body.name: \mathfrak H_{\mathrm{lb}}
body.construction: Build four subexperiments inside \(\mathcal M_n\): shell-localized treated-mean shifts for \(Q_{\kappa}\), an untreated-observation coupling at scale \(n^{-1/(\kappa+1)}\), a signed-cell fuzzy mixture at scale \(r_{en}^{2/(\kappa+2)}\) whose propensity tilt cancels its sign tilt in each observed row, and the analogous regular-cell control mixture. In every family calibrate the sole nonzero regression perturbation so that its \(L^2(P_X)\) norm is bounded by the applicable nuisance radius or by a fixed constant no larger than \(M^{1/2}\); combine the probability separations by a maximum-to-sum comparison.
